What we need from you to proceed:
- Confirm the precise thread timestamp range (start/end) and any message IDs if available (the .eml helps).

- We will not touch model training data or shared model artifacts — removal is limited to logs/indices/caches.
- We typically provide an "audit snippet" indicating which indices/keys were changed and a confirmation timestamp. For regulated customers we can include an operations runbook PDF describing the steps.

Next steps from our side: I'll loop in Rishi (Security) and Monica (Infrastructure Ops) to scope the work and confirm ETA. If you can reply with the specific timestamps and an approving delegate, we'll aim to start triage within 48 business hours.
